articles.summary: BEIJING, Aug. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Julong Holding Limited (“Julong” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: JLHL), a growth-oriented provider of intelligent integrated solutions, today announced its unaudited financial results for the six months ended March 31, 2026.
articles.title: Julong Holding Limited Reports Unaudited Financial Results for the First Half of Fiscal Year 2026
